testId: testim-migrated/tests/webstore/my-account/wishlist-validate-functionality.spec.ts > Webstore - My Account > validate wishlist functionality

scenario.summary: A registered user signs in from the header with the test's own credentials (guest storageState), empties the wishlist, adds/removes/re-adds a product from search results, checks the wishlist shows it (1 of 1) and removes it, adds a second product from its PDP, adds it to the cart from the wishlist, empties the cart, and removes it from the wishlist.
steps: Guest session; open home, sign in from the header with username/password; check the greeting contains accountName; clear the wishlist; check 'No records found.'
Search productSku1; toggle the wishlist heart on the first result: add (toast), remove (toast), add (toast)
Open Wishlist: has items, 'Showing 1 of 1', product link productName1; remove (toast); empty again
Search productSku2, open its PDP, add to wishlist (toast)
Wishlist: Add to Cart on the first item; check the cart heading; empty the cart; check the empty-cart message
Wishlist still has the item; remove it (toast); afterEach clears the wishlist and the cart
stateChanges: The account's wishlist is cleared, filled and emptied
One product is added to the cart and the cart is emptied
assertions: Cart heading after Add to Cart
Item still in the wishlist after Add to Cart
evidence: Title 'validate wishlist functionality' and the step labels match the flow

DECLARED ACCOUNT: although under my-account/ (webstore-auth project), the spec opts out of the shared session (test.use storageState empty) and signs in with username/password from its own JSON (credential sources). USER_WEBSTORE_REGISTERED preferred.required true on the username source; the migrated test declares it with await testData.useExisting('user', data.username) before signing in

Store MaxwellsHardware: webstore-auth uses testimEnv.web.baseUrl (WEB_BASE_URL, default webstore-z10-at), the store every migrated webstore spec runs on; the account's recorded records (orders, saved carts) are on PortalId 7 = MaxwellsHardware (tda rows)
